ic_name: MIPI SPMI v2.0 + RFFE v3.0 (System Power Management + RF Front-End Control)
module_role: MIPI two-wire control-bus interface: an SCLK/SDATA master and/or slave that frames transactions with a Sequence Start Condition (SSC) and Bus Park Cycle, protects every frame with odd parity, and uses 4-bit identifiers. As SPMI it is multi-master/multi-slave with arbitration, Request, DDB, and Reset/Sleep/Shutdown/Wakeup; as RFFE it is single-master controlling up to 15 RF front-end slaves with Masked Write, Timed/Triggered access, Mapped Register Write, and Interrupt handling.

integration_overview.physical_topology: All devices' SDA pins connected together; all SCL pins connected together; both lines pulled up to VDD via Rp.
integration_overview.drive_type: Open-drain / open-collector wired-AND (push-pull in Ultra Fast-mode only).
integration_overview.voltage_domain: VDD-dependent; mixed-voltage operation supported via Rp to highest VDD on bus (or via voltage-level translator).
integration_overview.max_devices: Limited by total bus capacitance Cb (typ ≤ 400 pF for Sm/Fm; ≤ 550 pF for Fm+) and address-space (≈ 112 free 7-bit addresses).
integration_overview.no_chip_select: Addressing is software-based via the 7-bit (or 10-bit) slave address byte — no per-device chip-select signal.
integration_overview.framed_by: Sequence Start Condition (SSC) + Bus Park Cycle
integration_overview.host_side_register_spec: Per-slave 8/16-bit register space; Register 0 special; SPMI DDB and RFFE ID registers for discovery.

interface_categories: MIPI two-wire transport — SCLK/SDATA, MSB-first, odd parity, SSC + Bus Park framing.
SPMI — multi-master arbitration, slave Request, DDB, power-state commands.
RFFE — single-master control, USID/GSID, triggers, Masked/Mapped writes, interrupts.
Register model — 8/16-bit register address, Register 0 short write.
interconnect_topologies_supported: Group addressing: SPMI Group Sub-ID; RFFE GSID.
Coexisting SPMI (system power) + RFFE (RF front-end) buses on one platform.
default_signal_values_when_idle: SCLK low, SDATA low (bus idle); devices listen for the next Sequence Start Condition.
soc_dependent_items: Number of masters/slaves and their MASTER_ID/SLAVE_ID (SPMI) or USID/GSID (RFFE) assignment.
Target clock rate (<=26 MHz SPMI / RFFE v1-v2; <=52 MHz RFFE v3.0).
Which commands are implemented (e.g. Authenticated, Masked Write, Mapped Register Write, triggers).
RFFE trigger mapping and PM-trigger coordination with the modem timeline.
SPMI arbitration priority assignment and bus-ownership policy.

low_power_modes.spmi: Reset / Sleep / Shutdown / Wakeup commands place slaves (or groups) into defined power states.
low_power_modes.bus: Two-wire CMOS bus idles low; low static power.

bus_clear_procedure: If SDA stuck LOW: master sends 9 SCL clock pulses to allow the device holding SDA LOW to release it. If SCL stuck LOW: use HW reset pin or cycle power.
topology_description: Multi-drop two-wire bus: devices share SCLK and SDATA. SPMI allows up to 4 masters and 16 slaves with arbitration and Transfer Bus Ownership; RFFE has a single master and up to 15 slaves (PA/LNA/switch/tuner/PMIC). Both coexist on a smartphone/modem platform.
